title: About Me
content: I enjoy learning new technologies and building projects that solve real problems.
My main interests are Full Stack Web Development, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI. I like exploring how these technologies can work together to build useful applications.
I enjoy creating complete web applications, understanding data, and using AI to make applications smarter and more helpful.
Apart from coding, I like learning how software works behind the scenes and always try to understand concepts instead of just following tutorials.
I believe that learning is a continuous journey, so I keep improving my skills by building projects, exploring new ideas, and practicing regularly.
My goal is to become a software developer who can build modern web applications, work with data, and create intelligent AI-powered solutions.
learningPhilosophy: I believe the best way to learn is by building real projects.
I enjoy understanding how things work instead of only learning how to use them.
Every project helps me improve my knowledge and become a better developer.
openSource: I enjoy exploring open-source projects to learn how real software is built and to improve my development skills.
collaboration: I enjoy learning from other developers, sharing ideas, and working together to build better software.
goal: My goal is to build useful products by combining web development, data, and artificial intelligence to solve real-world problems.
